name: Purple Swan 7
author: mnikita7767
description: Neon gradient cyan checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes inset 0 2px 2px #000000,
    inset 0 5px 5px #000000, inset 0 15px 25px #000000, text color changes from #111 to #fff, text-shadow becomes 0 0 5px #219cf3, 0 0 8px #219cf3.
